Steamed Cabbage
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 31, 2009 - 12:34am

Ingredients




2 med. light heads cabbage, quartered then shredded
2 tablespoons sugar
2 tablespoons oil
Heavy pot
2 tablespoons chopped onion
1/4 cup water
Salt to taste

Preparation

1 Heat oil in heavy pot. Add cabbage, water, sprinkle onion over top of cabbage and sugar. Let come to boiling stage, cut fire down and let steam until done. Don't over cook.
